Police Transfers Announced in Shahdol and Jammu & Kashmir

In Shahdol, police underwent a significant reshuffling with the Superintendent of Police (SP) transferring 29 police personnel. Separately, in Jammu & Kashmir, a large administrative reshuffle involved the transfer of 100 officials, including 28 IPS officers.
